title: Memory
note: Memory is the MEMORY.md the Agent writes itself, pinned into every Turn's prompt. This page is read-only and shows it as plain text, because its contents can be poisoned (ADR 0036).
needsOnline: The Machine must be online to read its Memory.
heading: The Agent's Memory
capped: The file is over the cap, so the Agent gets only the first {{limit}} characters plus a note to shorten it.
blank: The file is empty: nothing has been written yet.

empty.title: No Memory yet
empty.body: This Agent has never written a MEMORY.md in its Workdir.

missing.title: This Agent is gone
missing.body: It may have been deleted, or it lives on a Machine this device is not linked to.
